correctness.rationale: Directly derived commutator linearization on C_m^2. The image divisor and m*d kernel fiber counts follow from homomorphism theorem. For every prime factor, case t_p=1 versus t_p>1 gives necessary and sufficient sharp length using valuations. The identity fiber increases with d, so a divisors-only cutoff is also the least actual distribution cutoff. Indicator expansion yields exact lcm formula. Independent finite brute force verified 32 cases and 1,965 action cutoffs; finite checks do not substitute for the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Sharp first-stabilization length is a natural finite cutoff for repeated Engel word maps; the full value-frequency law and terminal probability answer more than a single bound. Prime-to-modulus action orders determine the terminal law while prime-power lifts determine the transient length, concretely distinguished by C_27 actions 2 versus 8 with the same C_18 complement. This is meaningful information for non-Frobenius/mixed-prime split metacyclic groups, rather than a routine restatement of a known Frobenius example.
